pr_title: Unquarantine fixed tests that have not failed in 30 days
pr_body:
Fixes #54754
Fixes #54447
~Fixes~ #57153
~Fixes~ #57259

#47967 was already closed, but the tests were still quarantined.
pr_comments:
I didn't look at https://dev.azure.com/dnceng-public/public/_test/analytics?definitionId=84&contextType=build closely enough. Both `VerifyCountersFireWithCorrectValues` and `EventCountersAndMetricsValues` have been failed in the last 30 days. Fortunately, the [PR checks](https://dev.azure.com/dnceng-public/public/_build/results?buildId=813688&view=ms.vss-test-web.build-test-results-tab) caught the failure.

I requarantined both tests, and I'll remove the `test-fixed` label from #57259 and keep it open.

comments: The root cause of this problem may affect any test that relies on catching `StaleElementReferenceException` as a way of detecting when an element was removed from the page. I've put this issue in the preview 7 milestone, but if we see similar test failures sooner, we should consider giving this a higher priority.

While this might theoretically affect other tests, I haven't seen it myself. And I just saw this test fail again at https://dev.azure.com/dnceng-public/public/_build/results?buildId=608920&view=ms.vss-test-web.build-test-results-tab.
